policies.evidence: IAC - AGENT - BLOCK - HighRiskAgent. Jon Hope's README for the policy (Updated/Documentation/IAC - AGENT - BLOCK - HighRiskAgent/README.md) at the pin 8af3b118 states its intent: "Blocks sign-in for AI agent identities assessed as high-risk by Entra Identity Protection." His export reads users includeUsers None, All resources, block, which targets nothing: the exporting SDK reads Conditional Access from Graph v1.0, and the agent fields exist only in Graph beta (src/baseline/discover.ts). Microsoft documents the shape (Graph beta, preview): every agent identity included (conditions.clientApplications.includeAgentIdServicePrincipals All), All resources, Block, and Agent risk (Preview) High (conditions.agentIdRiskLevels high). The pinned body is unchanged; the step's body adds these fields (owner, 2026-10-04: Jon's two AGENT blocks are steps).

IAC - AGENT - BLOCK - NonTrustedAgents. Jon Hope's README for the policy (Updated/Documentation/IAC - AGENT - BLOCK - NonTrustedAgents/README.md) at the pin 8af3b118 states its intent: "Blocks sign-in for AI agent identities that are not in the approved/trusted agent set. Implements a default-deny posture for agent workload identities — only explicitly approved agents can authenticate." His export reads users includeUsers None, All resources, block, which targets nothing: the exporting SDK reads Conditional Access from Graph v1.0, and the agent fields exist only in Graph beta (src/baseline/discover.ts). Microsoft documents the shape (Graph beta, preview): every agent identity included (conditions.clientApplications.includeAgentIdServicePrincipals All), All resources, Block, with the approved agent identities or agent blueprints excluded. Which agents a tenant approves is its own: IAMAI cannot read its agent identities, so the reconstruction excludes none and the operator excludes theirs before turning it on. The pinned body is unchanged; the step's body adds these fields (owner, 2026-10-04: Jon's two AGENT blocks are steps).
